tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: warm putty. The ground every clay object sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, secondary buttons: the default clay body.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed-in wells: text inputs, switch tracks, progress troughs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rare hairline dividers inside a card. Clay separates with depth, not lines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, clay-soft, mint-soft and danger-soft (11:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The signature terracotta-peach fill: primary buttons, active switch track, hero blocks. Never a text colour; put on-clay on it.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a clay fill (6.6:1 light, 8:1 dark). Never white.

tokens.name: clay-text
tokens.usage: Clay as text, links and the focus ring, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and clay-soft (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for clay badges and selected rows; text on it is ink or clay-text.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Secondary accent fill and success state fill; text on it is on-mint.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mint fill (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: mint-text
tokens.usage: Success text and mint as text, on surface, surface-raised and mint-soft (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for success and mint badges.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Highlight fill: a new-feature badge, a featured card, an illustration block. Text on it is on-butter only (ink fails in dark).

tokens.name: on-butter
tokens.usage: Text on a butter fill (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive labels on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and danger-soft (5.3:1 or better). Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind error messages and danger badges.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: an alias of clay-text, so a theme that moves clay-text moves links.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fredoka, a rounded geometric face, for big moments only. Hosted on Google Fonts (weights 500 and 600).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and card titles that lead a screen.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Nunito, rounded terminals that match the clay shapes. Hosted on Google Fonts (400, 600, 700, 800).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Three small habits, done before nine.

spacing.note: 4px base. Clay objects need air: their shadows fall 10 to 20px away, so leave at least space-4 between neighbours.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related items in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between clay objects (their shadows need it); compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, button padding inline (md).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid; large card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Generous and puffy. Nothing in Claymorph has a sharp corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small chips, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, hero blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, switch, avatars, icon buttons.

shadow.note: The clay recipe: one soft warm drop shadow out, a dark inner shade bottom-right and a white inner highlight top-left. That trio is what makes a flat fill look like a puffy object. Pressed states flip it inward.

tokens.name: shadow-clay
tokens.usage: Cards and large blocks at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, switch knob: small objects at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-lg
tokens.usage: Floating things: dialogs, menus, a hovered card.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed-in: text inputs, switch track, a button while held.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 3px surface gap, then 3px of solid clay-text (5:1 or better on every surface). Stack it before the element's clay shadow.
